snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_01: Buon giorno, $$name$$! Nice to have you back!
snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_02: Mmmm...is that freshly-caught fish I see? You want me to make fish fingers out of them? Didn't you know fish don't have fingers? And besides, fish fingers are made out of old math textbooks! Just kidding! I just ran out of the oil I need to fry them up. Find me some and I'll make you some fish fingers that are to die for.
snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_03: I've known some rather vain Pandas that like to smear oil all over their fur to make it glisten and shine. But I could use it to fry up some food!
snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_04: I need some oil to fry up the fish fingers. I've seen some Pandas rub oil on their fur to make it glisten and shine. Go find some pampered Pandas. The oil won't be far away. When you find some, bring it back here.
snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_05: Great, oil! What would I do without you? First I have to make 20 batches of fat-free French fries for a birthday party. If I'm late, there'll be trouble. I'll have those fish fingers ready for you by tomorrow.
snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_06: Calm your horses, now! Before I make your fish fingers, I have to make 20 batches of fat-free French fries for a birthday party. Come back tomorrow!
snippets.BRUNO_BIGFOOT_07: Ta dah! One serving of freshly-fried fish fingers! Don't eat them all at once!
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_01: Ahoy, little Panda! What? You want a wish? Now, look here, I'm no genie! You can't just go around demanding this and that!
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_02: Oh, a fish! I can help you out there! Now where did I leave my fishing tackle...I always seem to forget. I do remember that I had something flying around my head last time I had my pole and lures with me.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_03: If you can find my fishing-rod, I can get you a fish!
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_04: I can't catch them slippery fellers with my hands! Help me out and find my fishing-rod. The last time I had it, I remember there was some critter flying around my head.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_05: You found it! In a cave, you say? Nope, I have no idea what I was doing there. Go play a game or something and then come back. You know how it is - I don't like people watching me while I fish.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_05A: Here you go! I hope it'll do!
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_06: What do you mean Big Foot doesn't eat raw fish? That's a delicacy, you know. Ask Bruno at the restaurant. I'm sure he'll have an idea.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_07: Seen anything out of the ordinary? Can't say that I have. Yup, things are pretty quiet in my harbor. Sometimes the lifeguard and I like to get together and talk about water and water-related subjects. He told me that there was a very suspicious looking character wandering around the pool lately. I don't know much about it. You might want to ask him yourself.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_08: You want to open the closet in the locker room? You're going to need a key. Go ask Kamaria. She seems to always have keys around the castle.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_09: You say you found a secret passageway in the locker room? I'd be careful if I were you. Who knows what could be hiding down there! Maybe a shark or giant jelly fish! Or that whale I almost caught the summer of '52.
snippets.FISHERMAN_BIGFOOT_10: You want a game piece from me? I don't keep a thing like that lying around! Penny mentioned she found some puzzle piece as she was flipping through some books.
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_01: I am vegetarian and cannot help you with the fish fingers. Go see Bruno. He'll know what to do.
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_02: A giant hairdryer in Panfu? I thought I felt more hot air being spewed from Panfu than recently! It has to be at the top of a mountain! But how would one get there? There must be a secret passage!
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_03: A yellow light is shining forth from a locker? Why didn't you tell me that earlier?! I mean, isn't it obvious that something funny is going on there? If I could only remember where the key was...
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_04: I'm sure I stored that key somewhere in the attic and unfortunately things aren't too tidy up there. It'll be like trying to find a needle in a haystack. I'll need a bit of time to find it. Come back tomorrow. Hopefully I'll have it by then.
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_05: Come back tomorrow. Hopefully I'll be able to find it and then you can open that padlock.
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_06: Hey, I found this key ring. I'd bet the one you need is in there somewhere. Go try it out and I'll cross my fingers.
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_07: A secret passageway? It just has to lead to the hair dryer at the top of the mountain! Either that or Professor Bookworm's bedroom. Let's hope it's the mountain!
snippets.KAMARIA_BIGFOOT_08: You're looking for a game piece? Nope, I don't have one. There are some games in the library, though. Maybe you'll find one there.
snippets.LILI_BIGFOOT_02: So, you need a sewing kit and some strong material to build a sail for the Yeti?
snippets.LILI_BIGFOOT_03: Are you okay? Running a fever? How many fingers am I holding up?
snippets.LILI_BIGFOOT_04: I have heard that giving into these delusions is really the best thing one can do. Here you go! A sewing needle with thread. I'm going to have to look around a bit more to find the material you need. Come back tomorrow, okay?
snippets.LILI_BIGFOOT_05: I've got to search around in my studio for that material. Come back tomorrow to see if I've found any.
snippets.LILI_BIGFOOT_06: I see you're back. Still going on about the Yeti and giant hairdryer? In that case, here's some sturdy canvas! And say hi to that Yeti for me.
snippets.POPUP_BIGFOOT_01: You'll need a key to open this locker.
snippets.POPUP_BIGFOOT_02: You're going to have to solve the sliding puzzle to open the door. First look for the missing piece and put it in the door.
snippets.POPUP_BIGFOOT_03: Incorrect. Come back tomorrow and give it another go.
snippets.POPUP_BIGFOOT_04: Awesome! You unlocked a hidden item - keep trying to find the solution.
snippets.QUESTION_BIGFOOT_01: What is a Panda's favorite treat?%- Bamboo%- Chocolate%- French fries
snippets.QUESTION_BIGFOOT_02: In which country do Pandas live in the wild?%- China%- Australia%- Iceland
snippets.QUESTION_BIGFOOT_03: What is the latin name for a Panda?%- Ailuropoda melanoleuca%- Homo neanderthalensis%- Phascolarctos cinereus
snippets.QUEST_HINT: Hello! You have to finish the quest you are playing right now before you can play my adventure. Come back then.
snippets.TRAINER_BIGFOOT_01: I'm glad you're here. Can you take a look in the changing room? Yeah, I'd do it myself, but I have to...uhh...wash this...ummm...pool!
snippets.TRAINER_BIGFOOT_02: Recently I saw this Panda go in and he never came out. He's either taking a really long time to get his swimsuit on or is up to something. Either way, I'm scared to walk in on him!
snippets.TRAINER_BIGFOOT_03: I have an idea! Why don't you go check on him? I'll wait for you here. If you are not out within 12 hours, I will get someone to come in after you!
snippets.TRAINER_BIGFOOT_04: The key to the locker? You'd better ask Kamaria. She has the keys to everything, but she seems to be a bit scatter-brained. Good luck finding them!
snippets.TRAINER_BIGFOOT_05: A secret passageway? In my changing room? Who's going to pay for those repairs? Is it even structurally sound or did he dig it with a spoon? This isn't coming out of my paycheck!
snippets.TRAINER_BIGFOOT_06: You're looking for a game piece? Penny mentioned that she saw a puzzle piece as she was flipping through some books recently.
snippets.WARNING_FINISH_QUEST: You have $number_of_days$ days left to finish the Big Foot quest.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_01: Oh...my...I am starving...please, bring me something to eat! Fish! Please hurry...
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_02: I'm starving, I tell you! Please bring me something to eat. No, not ice cream. Fish!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_03: Excuse me? Raw fish? I think not. Take it back and cook it fully. Do you want me to get sick?
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_04: Mmmmm...warm, crunchy fish fingers! Just what I needed! You've saved me from both hunger and the danger of eating raw seafood!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_05: I have to rescue my family. We are the last of the Yetis and have lived for years on our little- yet comfortable- glacier not far from here.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_06: We've lived there in peace for years until one day, an evil guy named Bonez came across our dwelling and has been trying to hunt us down ever since. He's a very crafty guy. You see, he climbed to the top of the highest mountain in Panfu and set up a gigantic hair dryer. He leaves the hair dryer on high and never gives us a break with a cool jet stream of air! Our home is melting and our hair is totally dried out and full of split ends!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_07: Our little glacier is the only safe place in the world for us. Bonez plans to sell my family to the zoo if he manages to catch all of us. He'll make a pretty penny off of us fine specimens.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_08: I beg of you! Find the giant hairdryer and turn the thing off! Our livelihood is in your hands!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_09: I'm afraid I don't know on which mountain top the giant hairdryer is located. Try asking around. Someone is sure to know something!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_10: You've just gotta turn off that giant hairdryer! It's melting my icey home. I just know that Bonez is going to try to sell me and my family to a zoo!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_11: You were able to turn off the giant hairdryer? That means my family is safe! You are quite the Panda!
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_12: There's one itsy bitsy problem, however. The glacier I arrived on has melted by now. How am I supposed to get back to my family?
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_13: Maybe you can help me build a sail to attached to a block of ice. We're going to need lots of ice and a sail, too. I think I would be able to make the sail if I had the right materials. I'll need a stick, a sewing needle, and some strong material.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_14: You can find sticks near trees, so that shouldn't be too hard. Go find one and bring it here.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_15: What a perfect stick you've found. Now I'll need a swath of material to use for the sail. And also a needle and thread to sew it all together. Isn't there a clothing designer in Panfu? Lili Panphung? I'm sure she has some stuff we could use.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_16: Go talk to Lili. She'll be able to provide us with some material and sewing supplies.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_17: Now I have everything I need. I'll attach the sail to a glacier, but we'll have to make that too. Bring me as many ice cubes as you can find. You think there could be an ice machine somewhere in Panfu?
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_18: Bring me as many ice cubes as possible so that I can make a raft out of ice.
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_19: Excellent! Now I have everything I need! You sure do rise to the occasion, my Panda friend. How can I possibly thank you?
snippets.YETI_BIGFOOT_20: I know just the thing - an igloo! You can use it instead of your tree house. I hope you like it. Now to find my family. See you around!
